invariants.rationale: The computed layout width originates from getWidth(), which is used as a dimension.
Layout height comes from getHeight(), which should also be non-negative as a screen dimension.
The number of columns is used as a loop bound and array length.
The number of rows is likewise used as an array length and loop bound, so must be non-negative.
getChildren() is called and its return value is used immediately; thus it cannot be null.
